description: Final build fix pass - ensure flutter analyze passes with zero errors and flutter build apk succeeds. Fix all import errors, missing references, type issues, unused imports, and any compilation problems across all new and modified files. Verify the complete app_router.dart is consistent, all providers are properly typed, and the app compiles cleanly.
steps: 1. Read the complete app_router.dart and verify ALL imports exist for every screen referenced. Fix any missing imports.
2. Check all provider files for proper typing - ensure no raw types, all generics specified, no missing return statements.
3. Verify pubspec.yaml has all required dependencies (shared_preferences for settings, etc - all already listed).
4. Check that analysis_options.yaml rules are satisfied: prefer_const_constructors, prefer_single_quotes, avoid_print, use_build_context_synchronously.
5. Ensure no circular imports between features.
6. Verify all StatelessWidget/StatefulWidget classes have proper const constructors where possible.
7. Check that the profile_screen.dart properly imports and navigates to all new screens.
8. Verify the app.dart dark theme integration works with the settings provider.
9. Make sure assets/ directory structure matches what pubspec.yaml declares (assets/images/ and assets/icons/ must exist even if empty - add .gitkeep files if needed).
10. Run a mental compile check on every file to ensure there are no obvious Dart errors (mismatched brackets, missing semicolons, wrong type annotations).
11. Ensure the supabase/schema.sql is syntactically valid SQL with no duplicate policy names or missing table references.
12. Check that all files use single quotes (per analysis_options.yaml prefer_single_quotes rule).
acceptance_criteria: All Dart files have valid syntax with no compilation errors
All imports resolve correctly (no dangling references)
app_router.dart imports and routes are complete and consistent
pubspec.yaml assets declarations match actual directory structure
The entire codebase would pass flutter analyze and flutter build apk in CI
verification: Read key files (app_router.dart, app.dart, profile_screen.dart) to verify final state
Spot-check random new files for syntax correctness
Verify no obvious import/type errors remain
